mapping_status: Independent case study with simulated business requirements; narrow project labels, not official O*NET® categories.
split_policy: 60/20/20 approximate occupation-group allocation within each label; all tasks from one exact SOC code stay together; vocabulary must be fitted on train only.
dedup_policy: NFKC, casefold, punctuation/whitespace normalization; all members of repeated normalized-text clusters removed globally before splitting.
limitations: O*NET® tasks are not real job advertisements.
Narrow categories omit many valid occupations; classifier is closed-set and confidence does not guarantee out-of-scope detection.
Exact normalized deduplication does not eliminate near duplicates or shared terminology.
Only six software occupations are selected, so grouped uncertainty estimates will be imprecise.
Source hashes record downloaded bytes; no independently trusted expected hash is supplied.
Threshold selection and calibration must use validation only; final test must remain untouched until evaluation.
